en: {fb:6D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...It really is a beautiful painting. I never tire of it, no matter how often I see it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Hmph. Flattery or not, I suppose I should thank you,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}since it's a painting of my parents...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...Um, are there other paintings by your father, Sievas?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}No. This is the only one left now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{e5:0300}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}My grandfather burned every last one of the others.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{e5:0500}{spk:E783}{n}...Why would he do that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}The grandfather who raised me hated my father fiercely...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}He saw my father as the man who stole his child, made her miserable, and in the end killed her.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}So he bought up my father's paintings, whatever the price, wherever they hung, sparing no expense...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...and threw every one of them into the flames.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}But your father died in the great fire too...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}My parents' marriage was never accepted by those around them.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}My grandfather, a great noble, would never allow his daughter to marry a poor painter.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}My mother ran away from home and lived with my father in Joost.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}So I suppose my grandfather wanted revenge on my father.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}But why go that far...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Who knows...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}But this painting is the only one that escaped that obsession.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}It had been donated to the church, and the abbess here refused to sell it to my grandfather.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Even my grandfather couldn't lay a hand on the church.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Now this painting is the only proof in this world that my parents ever lived...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Nothing else is left...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I seem to have talked too much today...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Let's go.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{f6:12800080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}(Looks like he's on a date with a girl again...){n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: {f7:E783}Say, Lord Sievas, my father says he'd like to meet you soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Mm.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: But I thought that might be a bother for you, Lord Sievas.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Mm.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: Lately I've been trying not to talk about you to Father much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Mm.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: ...Lord Sievas, I'm being serious here.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Hm? ...I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: Honestly, Lord Sievas! Why are you so absent-minded?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I was just thinking about another woman...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: Thinking about some other girl while I'm talking to you seriously...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Girl: I'm going home!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:D500}{spk:0080}{n}Sigh...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{f5:4880}{n}{ea:0180}{n}{e6}{ee:0080}{n}{e8:0180}{n}{e9:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What's wrong? A playboy like you, treating a woman like that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:D600}{spk:0080}{n}It's you... Who knows. I just wasn't in the mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Hehe, a slump?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:D700}{e5:0600}{spk:0080}{n}Perhaps.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:D800}{spk:0080}{n}That's right, {name:0080}. Would you keep me company for a while?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}What...?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}An invitation from a playboy in a slump... I'm not so sure...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:D900}{e5:0600}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Harsh.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Well, compared to how you treated me that time...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:DA00}{spk:0080}{n}That bad joke...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}It really hurt me... that did.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:DB00}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry... I apologize from the bottom of my heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}You're unusually honest tonight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:DC00}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Heh, I always wish to treat women kindly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Hehe, there you go again with your smooth talk...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6880}{n}{e0:DE00}{spk:0080}{n}...Though I've no idea what to talk about with an angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}You don't need to worry about that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:DF00}{spk:0080}{n}Sweet words praising your looks, society gossip, talk of art... I doubt an angel like you would enjoy any of it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I'll listen to whatever you want to talk about, Sievas.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E000}{spk:0080}{n}I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E100}{spk:0080}{n}...Do you remember that painting in the church?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Yes... It's such a shame. It was so precious to you...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E200}{spk:0080}{n}Yes... But there's something I only understood after it was gone.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E300}{spk:0080}{n}The real reason I went to see that painting...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}The real reason?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E400}{spk:0080}{n}I...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E500}{spk:0080}{n}I was simply afraid of forgetting what my mother looked like...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E600}{spk:0080}{n}My childhood memories, fading little by little...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E700}{spk:0080}{n}I thought that painting might hold them back... That's what I believed.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E800}{spk:0080}{n}My parents' faces, their figures, their voices... all blurring until I can't remember them...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E900}{spk:0080}{n}It isn't loneliness or anything like that. I was just... afraid...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:EA00}{spk:0080}{n}...A childish story, isn't it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:EB00}{spk:0080}{n}...A man with so weak a heart surely isn't worthy of being a hero.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...No, Sievas. Those are your honest feelings...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I don't think that makes you unworthy of being a hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E000}{spk:0080}{n}I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:EC00}{spk:0080}{n}Thank you...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:ED00}{spk:0080}{n}You're kind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Not at all... I only said what I think...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:EE00}{spk:0080}{n}...When this battle is over, will you go back to these Heavens of yours?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}That hasn't been decided yet...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I haven't heard anything from the Archangel Gabriel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:EF00}{spk:0080}{n}If...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:F000}{spk:0080}{n}If you do have to go back...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:F100}{spk:0080}{n}I'd ask that you not vanish without a word...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...Of course, I would never do that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:F200}{e5:0600}{spk:0080}{n}I see...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:F300}{spk:0080}{n}...Then that's all right.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:F400}{e5:0000}{spk:0080}{n}Let's go back... It's gotten late.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sorry for keeping you out so late.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Not at all...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{f7:0080}　｛It's part of an angel's duty｝{n}{f7:0080}　｛For you, Sievas...　　　　　｝{n}{end}
{fb:6A80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}This is part of an angel's duty too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{e5:0200}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...I see... Duty, is it...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}For you, Sievas, I don't mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{e5:0400}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...I see.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...The time for the decisive battle will come.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}The monster I have history with and the fallen angels are powerful foes.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}But I will defeat them without fail and end this battle.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}So lend me your strength a while longer, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Yes, of course...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Well, until next time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...Good night, Sievas.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Good night, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}No, I think I'll decline your company tonight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{e5:0200}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...I see... What a pity.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I think being alone isn't so bad once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...True. Perhaps I should let the night air cool my head.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Good night then, Sievas.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, good night, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sievas, so this is where you were!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}You... I'm surprised you knew I'd be here...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Why did you suddenly disappear?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Why is that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...To be honest, I no longer understand...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}what it means to fight as a hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}But you've fought all this way...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, I've fought. But after hearing that beast's last words...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}That heroes are just pawns in the war...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Of course I know you don't see it that way...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}But I simply can't go on fighting as an angel's hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}and accept it as readily as I did before...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...Sievas. We angels can't force heroes to fight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}But I believe that anyone with the makings of a hero will always choose, of their own will,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}to fight for justice and for peace.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I believe in you, Sievas.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...I appreciate those words, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...It's no use?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Not now... Let me think...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Do you know what's become of that burned-down church?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{f5:5180}{n}{ea:5280}{n}{e6}{ee:0180}{n}{e8:0180}{n}{e9:0180}{n}{ed}{eb}{spk:0080}{n}A pile of rubble, I suppose. Nothing was left...{n}{wait}{clear}{f5:F580}{n}{ea:0180}{n}{e6}{ee:0080}{n}{e8:0180}{n}{e9:0180}{n}{ed}{eb}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}...From that pile of rubble, people are working together to rebuild the church...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Everyone was hurt by the fighting...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}But even so, there are people desperately trying to stand back up without giving in.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you a proud knight?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}You're not the only one who's been hurt...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you were someone who knew his duty as a noble.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Someone who, for all his joking, would take the lead in facing danger for others.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Someone with that kind of pride...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Were you really so weak that something like this could break you?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Sievas, please think about it once more.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Sievas!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{f6:03800080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Very well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'll fight as a hero once more, {name:0080}.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Thank goodness... That's the Sir Sievas I know.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...It seems I'd lost my nerve.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}No, I understand how you feel, Sievas...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Your family has been a victim of this war.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Yes. But even now, the fallen angels are making people suffer...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If I doubt the angels now, I'd be playing right into their hands...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}As a knight, on my pride, I will fight for peace. To the very end.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, Sievas... I knew you would.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Now, let's go.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Sorry, but standing there won't make me do anything.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
